I've finally found a good personal assistant after years of saying I needed one.

Over the last several weeks, my brother told me I needed to give GrokBot a shot.

I was always (ironically) too busy, and never made time for it - until last night.

I've organized my calendar, cleared tens of thousands of emails that were backlogged, and started building out automated research assistants.

Would way rather figure out how to maximize productivity when the market is slow than when we're back to up only when you really don't get a chance to breathe.

Highly recommend spending a few hours playing around with @bot if you haven't yet.

robinhood:0x7fe995a80075df3dc8ae11a9b82c7fe4202cd87f 

Robinhood Chain is still only four months old.

It reignited activity in the trenches for all chains immediately after it launched in the midst of an otherwise dead market for crypto.

If it can do that when majors like Bitcoin & ETH are still well off all time highs, imagine what it will do when retail fomos back in again.

HOOD has access to more retail mindshare than any other new L1 / L2 we've seen released in the ten years I've been in this space.

It's the primary reason why I've consistently bull posted it since launch.

I am confident it's only a matter of time before culture coins on the chain make a big move.

e.g. we saw the early stages with CASHCAT running, but we've yet to see any meme on the chain scratch the surface of billions.

I'm sure Vlad and the team are very aware of the criticism they've received for not pushing the chain as hard as what the public perceives they *should* at this point.

I'm also sure the man who had the vision to build a chain that became the home for the heart of retail traders has a vision for making their chain the same place in the world of crypto.

If Solana was able to receive the type of retail attention it did last cycle with no real infrastructure heading into it, and much more initial friction for bridging capital over... imagine what Robinhood Chain will be if Vlad puts even a fraction of the effort into it that he's put into the main Robinhood app.

That's why I don't think it's insane that coins like CASHCAT and HMM can run higher than BONK and WIF ever did last cycle.

Still early.

Learn to bullieve in something again.

Billions will think 🤔🐈
